verdicts.title: Gorenstein Multiple Structures on Smooth Algebraic Varieties
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We characterize the Gorenstein nilpotent scheme structures on a smooth algebraic variety as support, in terms of a duality property of the graded objects associated to two canonical filtrations.
